tools.description: Extend an existing video using Veo. The input video must be MP4, 1-30s, 24fps, and 720p/1080p/4k in 16:9 or 9:16. Output is a 7s extension. Video is saved to GCS and optionally downloaded locally.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated videos. Note: supported aspect ratios are model-dependent.

bucket.description: Google Cloud Storage bucket where the API will save the generated video(s) (e.g., your-bucket/output-folder or gs://your-bucket/output-folder). If not provided, GENMEDIA_BUCKET env var will be used. One of them is required.

generate_audio.description: Optional. Generate audio for the video. Only supported by Veo 3 models. Defaults to true.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the input video. Currently, only 'video/mp4' is supported. If not provided, assumed to be video/mp4.

model.description:
Model for video generation. Can be a full model ID or a common name. Supported models:
- *veo-2.0-generate-001* (Durations: [5, 6, 7, 8]s, Max Videos: 4, Ratios: 16:9, 9:16) Aliases: *Veo 2*
- *veo-2.0-generate-exp* (Durations: [5, 6, 7, 8]s, Max Videos: 4, Ratios: 16:9, 9:16) Aliases: *Veo 2 Exp*
- *veo-2.0-generate-preview* (Durations: [5, 6, 7, 8]s, Max Videos: 4, Ratios: 16:9, 9:16) Aliases: *Veo 2 Preview*
- *veo-3.0-fast-generate-001* (Durations: [4, 6, 8]s, Max Videos: 2, Ratios: 16:9) Aliases: *Veo 3.0 Fast*
- *veo-3.0-generate-001* (Durations: [4, 6, 8]s, Max Videos: 2, Ratios: 16:9) Aliases: *Veo 3.0*
- *veo-3.1-fast-generate-001* (Durations: [4, 6, 8]s, Max Videos: 4, Ratios: 16:9, 9:16) Aliases: *Veo 3.1 Fast*
- *veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview* (Durations: [4, 6, 8]s, Max Videos: 4, Ratios: 16:9, 9:16) Aliases: *Veo 3.1 Fast Preview*
- *veo-3.1-generate-001* (Durations: [4, 6, 8]s, Max Videos: 4, Ratios: 16:9, 9:16) Aliases: *Veo 3.1*
- *veo-3.1-generate-preview* (Durations: [4, 6, 8]s, Max Videos: 4, Ratios: 16:9, 9:16) Aliases: *Veo 3.1 Preview*
- *veo-3.1-lite-generate-001* (Durations: [4, 6, 8]s, Max Videos: 4, Ratios: 16:9, 9:16) Aliases: *Veo 3.1 Lite*

num_videos.description: Number of videos to generate. Note: the maximum is model-dependent.

output_directory.description: Optional. If provided, specifies a local directory to download the generated video(s) to. Filenames will be generated automatically.

output_filename.description: Optional. Base name for the output file(s). The extension is forced to the true video type (e.g. .mp4). For a single video the name is used as-is (foo.mp4); for multiple videos a 1-based suffix is inserted before the extension (foo_1.mp4, foo_2.mp4, ...). For GCS output the API-written objects are copy-renamed to this name after generation (adds a short GCS copy latency; larger videos add copy time proportional to size).

person_generation.description: Whether to allow generating videos with people. Supported values: 'dont_allow', 'allow_adult'.

prompt.description: Optional text prompt to guide video extension.

seed.description: Optional. Non-negative integer seed for best-effort reproducible video generation.

video_uri.description: GCS URI of the input video for extension (e.g., gs://your-bucket/input-video.mp4).
